question: Give the number of votes for the post about data visualization.
evidence: About data visualization is the Title that contains 'data visualization';
clarification: Count each distinct Id only once.
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T1.Title LIKE '%data visualization%'
gold0: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T1.Title LIKE '%data visualization%'

d.request: How many votes does the post with “data visualization” in its title have, counting each distinct vote ID only once?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.Id) FROM votes AS v JOIN posts AS p ON v.PostId = p.Id WHERE LOWER(p.Title) LIKE '%data visualization%'

b.request: Count the distinct vote IDs for posts whose Title contains “data visualization”
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.Id) FROM votes AS v JOIN posts AS p ON v.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data visualization%';

c.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.Id) AS vote_count FROM votes AS v JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = v.PostId WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data visualization%';
